notebook.notes:
# FM radio – perfboard transcription

THT-only layout transcribed from the hand-drawn FM radio sketch. Board is 44×18 holes at 2.54 mm pitch with plated-through holes, so top and bottom pads are electrically connected.

Keep the RF section physically short. Q1–Q4 are generic TO-92 footprints with editor pin order E-B-C; verify the real transistor pinout before soldering.

Sketch-derived values retained: L1 = 5 turns Ø5 mm (the sketch also has a 100 µH note), L2 = 22 µH, L3 = 4 turns Ø5 mm with 5–30 pF trimmer, IF1 = 10.7 MHz, L4 = 10 mH, BB105 varicap, 2×1N4148 detector/clamp pair. The crowded Q2–Q3 and BB105 area is kept intentionally simple rather than redesigned.

tasks.text: Verify Q1–Q4 transistor pinout against the actual parts before soldering.
Wind/fit L1 and L3 with short leads and keep them separated from long jumpers.
Check the 10.7 MHz IF part and BB105 orientation against the original sketch.
Continuity-check +9V and GND rails before powering the board.
